name: Mrk 1434 (Hubble)
blurb: Mrk 1434, a metal-poor dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: mrk1434-hubble
story: A small, metal-poor galaxy busy forming stars, with two X-ray sources glowing inside it, one near its nucleus. Hubble looked closely at its core to help learn whether a massive black hole is hiding there.

claims.text: Mrk 1434 is a metal-poor dwarf galaxy
Mrk 1434 is included in an atlas of blue compact dwarf galaxies
Mrk 1434 contains two X-ray sources, the northern one toward the galactic nucleus
The Hubble program aimed to investigate candidate nuclear black holes in dwarf galaxies and to isolate the optical nucleus
